description: This file implements functions related to atomic counters in HLSL, including generating atomic counter function names, emitting function headers, and managing atomic counter operations within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: AtomicCounterFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class for implementing atomic counter functions in HLSL within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: AtomicCounterFunctionHLSL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the atomic counter handler with optional force resolution.

methods.name: useAtomicCounterFunction
methods.description: Generates and returns the HLSL function name for a given atomic counter operation.

methods.name: atomicCounterFunctionHeader
methods.description: Outputs the HLSL function definitions for atomic counter operations.

methods.name: getAtomicCounterNameForBinding
methods.description: Returns the atomic counter name string for a specific binding index.
